title: Railroads
summary: Individual railroads are "Group 1" entities established only as name headings (tag 110) and may be assigned as subjects even if the name includes "Company" or its equivalent. Works on administrative matters get only the name heading; works on the railroad as a physical entity or on substantive aspects also get Railroads--[place] (or a more specific heading such as Narrow gauge railroads--[place]) plus headings for specific topics.
validation_rules: Individually named railroads are established only as corporate name headings (tag 110 in the name authority file; assigned as 610), not as 650/651 subject headings. (H 1970 background)
A railroad's corporate name heading may be assigned as a subject even if it includes the word "Company" or its equivalent in any language. (H 1970 background)
Assign the railroad name heading as established in AACR2/RDA form in the name authority file. (H 1970 sec. 1)

For works on the railroad as a physical entity or on substantive aspects, also assign `Railroads--[place]` or a more specific heading of this type, e.g. `Narrow gauge railroads--[place]`; specific topics get headings such as `Locomotives--[place]`. (H 1970 sec. 2)
For works only on administrative matters (business affairs, finances, personnel), assign only the railroad's name heading. (H 1970 sec. 2)

sections.heading: 1. Assigning the heading for an individual railroad
sections.text: If an AACR2 or RDA heading for an individual railroad has been established in the name authority file, assign it as established. If the heading is not established or is not coded as an AACR2 or RDA heading, establish it or change it as necessary.

sections.heading: 2. Assigning additional headings to the work being cataloged
sections.text:
If the work deals only with administrative matters relating to the railroad company, such as business affairs, finances, personnel, etc., assign only the appropriate name heading as a subject. If, however, the work deals with the railroad as a physical entity, including the line, track, rolling stock, buildings associated with the railroad, etc., or if it deals with specific substantive aspects of the railroad, also assign the topical heading Railroads--[place] or a more specific heading of this type, such as Narrow gauge railroads--[place]. Bring out any specific topics by assigning additional headings, for example, Locomotives--[place]. Examples:

```
Title: Annual report of the Board of Directors to the Stockholders of the Pennsylvania Rail Road Company.
610 20 $a Pennsylvania Railroad $v Periodicals.

Title: The Ma & Pa : a history of the Maryland & Pennsylvania Railroad.
610 20 $a Maryland and Pennsylvania Railroad Company $x History.
650 #0 $a Railroads $z Maryland $x History.
650 #0 $a Railroads $z Pennsylvania $x History.

Title: Rio Grande diesels : a pictorial history.
610 20 $a Denver and Rio Grande Western Railroad Company $x History $v Pictorial works.
650 #0 $a Railroads $z West (U.S.) $x History $v Pictorial works.
650 #0 $a Diesel locomotives $z West (U.S.) $x History $v Pictorial works.

Title: Steam on the SNCF.
610 20 $a Société nationale des chemins de fer français.
650 #0 $a Railroads $z France.
650 #0 $a Steam locomotives $z France.

Title: The seashore's finest train.
650 #0 $a Blue Comet (Express train) $x History.
610 20 $a Central Railroad of New Jersey $x History.
650 #0 $a Railroads $z New Jersey $x History.

Title: A Catskill souvenir : scenes on the line of the Ulster and Delaware Railroad.
651 #0 $a Catskill Mountains (N.Y.) $x Description and travel.
610 20 $a Ulster & Delaware Railroad.
650 #0 $a Railroads $z New York (State)

Title: Baltimore and Ohio Railroad employees : 1842 and 1852, 1855 and 1857.
610 20 $a Baltimore and Ohio Railroad Company $x Employees $x History $y 19th century.
650 #0 $a Wages $x Railroads $z United States $x History $y 19th century.
651 #0 $a Middle Atlantic States $v Genealogy.
651 #0 $a Virginia $v Genealogy.
651 #0 $a West Virginia $v Genealogy.
651 #0 $a Ohio $v Genealogy.
```
